check_events.outcome: The two-endpoint condition gives an endpoint-pair map A→P₂(S). The stated strictness makes this map injective, so identifying A with its image gives the stated data by a subset of P₂(S). This confirms the role of the notation without changing the ink or resolving the extra axiom glyph.

For a two-element set a, the coordinate unit vectors lie in I^a and satisfy the written sum condition; they give the stated injection a↪seg(a). Either consistent dummy index x or n would express the same construction, so this check does not settle that pale glyph.
